title: List all workspace collaborators
task_brief: Use API-get-users to retrieve and display a list of all users in the Notion workspace, including their names and roles.

title: Find and summarize travel itinerary
task_brief: Use API-post-search to locate the Japan Travel Planner page, then use API-get-block-children to retrieve its content and create a brief summary of the main itinerary points.

title: Add completion comment to project
task_brief: Navigate to the Team Projects page using API-post-search, retrieve its details with API-retrieve-a-page, and use API-create-a-comment to add a comment marking a project milestone as complete.

title: Update resume contact information
task_brief: Use API-post-search to find the Online Resume page, then use API-patch-page to update a contact property (such as email or phone number) with new information.

title: Create new troubleshooting entry
task_brief: Navigate to the IT Troubleshooting Hub using API-post-search, then use API-patch-block-children to append a new troubleshooting entry with a problem description and solution steps.

title: Organize Python learning topics
task_brief: Use API-post-search to locate the Python Roadmap page, retrieve its blocks with API-get-block-children, and use API-update-a-block to reorganize or clarify a specific learning topic's description.

title: Create company onboarding checklist
task_brief: Navigate to Company In A Box using API-post-search, then use API-post-page to create a new child page titled 'New Employee Onboarding Checklist' with basic checklist items added via API-patch-block-children.

title: Extract and verify SOP compliance rule
task_brief: Use API-post-search to find the Standard Operating Procedure page, retrieve a specific block using API-retrieve-a-block, and extract a compliance rule to verify its current wording matches expected policy.

title: Archive completed coursework
task_brief: Navigate to the Computer Science Student Dashboard using API-post-search, identify a completed course page, and use API-move-page to relocate it to an 'Archived Courses' section (creating the section first if needed with API-post-page).

title: Add Toronto restaurant recommendation
task_brief: Use API-post-search to locate the Toronto Guide page, then use API-patch-block-children to add a new block containing a restaurant recommendation with name, cuisine type, and location details.
